notes: Read the complete 422-line source hook line by line before editing and preserved every exported hook name, query key, enabled gate, retry flag, select transform, polling interval, staleTime, mutation path, request body, toast fallback, and API path without adding /api/v1.

Source is non-visual API/type code; the native output uses the React Native-safe parity request client and Alert-backed mutation toast bridge, with no DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI imports.

Inlined the web energy response/payload interfaces, safeArray guard, STALE_TIMES, INTERVALS, and query-broadcast shim because the native parity layer does not expose the web @/types/energy, @/lib/safeArray, @/lib/constants, or @/lib/queryBroadcast aliases.

The source battery health hook depends on URL-mounted useAsOfDate; native has no browser URL state, so this conversion explicitly exposes a live-state-only as-of capability while keeping the same battery request path shape for live reads.
